meta.name: add-tavily-tool
meta.description: Add Tavily Search and Extract as keyless remote MCP tools for selected NanoClaw agent groups. Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加免密钥的搜索与网页提取能力到智能体组
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在用 NanoClaw 管理智能体，希望它们能直接搜索网页和提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Add keyless web search and extraction to your agent groups.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage NanoClaw agents and want them to search the web without an API key.

howto.what: 它给选定的 NanoClaw agent 群组装上 Tavily 远程 MCP 工具,含网页搜索和 URL 提取两个工具,无需 API key;Crawl、Map、Research 会被过滤掉。
howto.when: 当你想在不提供 API key 的情况下安装 Tavily 网页搜索或 URL 提取时触发;注册与重启按群组逐个用 ncl 命令执行。

say.text: 给 group-a 注册 Tavily 搜索和提取工具
say.note: 会装 mcp-remote 并注册 tavily 服务

say.text: 检查 group-a 的 Tavily 配置里两个 header 对不对
say.note: 跑 ncl groups config get 核对

say.text: Tavily 返回 429 了,帮我准备付费 key 的升级链接
say.note: 会生成 OneCLI 预填链接

howto.what_en: It installs the mcp-remote bridge in the agent image and registers Tavily's remote MCP server for selected groups, exposing only tavily_search and tavily_extract with no API key.
howto.when_en: Use when installing Tavily web search or URL extraction without an API key; registration and restart run per group via ncl commands.

say_en.text: Register Tavily search and extract for group-a.
say_en.note: Adds mcp-remote and the tavily server

say_en.text: Check group-a's Tavily config has both headers.
Tavily returned 429 — prep the paid-key upgrade link.
